prompt: Use implementation-planning to produce the operational design and TDD plan for THUMB-31 from the attached repository evidence. Do not change code.
expected_output: A plan with private per-delivery workspaces, failure-safe cleanup, bounded startup repair, preserved primary errors, post-write success despite cleanup failure, and bounded telemetry.
expectations: Attempt cleanup after success, retryable failure, and permanent failure.
Preserve the processing error when processing and cleanup both fail.
Map only UnsupportedImageError to permanent failure.
Test object-write success plus cleanup failure, duplicate delivery, startup sweep isolation, and root-scan failure.
critical_forbidden_outcomes: Cleaning only on success or masking a primary error.
Retrying after a completed object write solely because cleanup failed.
Deleting the temporary root, unrelated entries, or a current session.
Using job IDs or paths as metric labels.
Claiming ready without admitted commands and same-revision reviews.
